about: Which numbers belong to which part of Delentia and where each one is kept. It records WHERE a number lives, not the number: the numbers are read from their sources by scripts/check_versions.py, so this file cannot disagree with them. Policy: docs/release/VERSIONING_POLICY.md.

milestone.name: Delentia OS — Public Technical Preview 0.1
milestone.meaning: Anyone can install the runtime (pip or the Windows installer) and run it on their own machine with a model of their choice, supervised, and can check what it did. A milestone is a label for what has been opened to whom. It is not a package version and is never used as a git tag (release.yml and trigger-ecosystem-release.yml act on v* tags).
opens: the Desk on the owner's own machine
stays_closed: other people using a chat channel
any claim that a capable model has driven the agent

gates.G-install: met (CI: the built wheel installs and starts in an empty environment)
gates.G-mediation: met (six doors, with a mutation test)
gates.G-approval: met (model check, crash windows with real processes)
gates.G-operator: met as text; no operator other than the author has used it
gates.G-installer: built and run on the author's machine only; a clean machine, SmartScreen and an offline install are not yet checked
gates.G-windows-hello: not yet tested with a real device
gates.G-model: not met (no capable model has driven the loop; this belongs to L2, not to this milestone)

python_runtime.version_rule: SemVer. Only ever goes up. One number: every release of the runtime, its CLI, its API and the Desk it carries has it.

desk.version_rule: the Desk is built into the wheel, so it has the runtime's number and no number of its own; apps/gui/package.json is a private build file, not a release number

windows_installer.distribution: GitHub Release asset: Delentia-Setup-<runtime version>.exe, and the fixed name Delentia-Setup.exe for the latest release
windows_installer.version_rule: the runtime version it installs (the first three numbers); the fourth number of the Windows file version is the installer's own revision, 0 unless the installer was rebuilt without a runtime change

typescript_sdk.version_rule: SemVer of its own public API; moves only when the SDK changes; released by an sdk-v* tag

fdia_wasm.version_rule: SemVer of its own; released by an sdk-v* tag

rct_edge.version_rule: SemVer of its own; released by an sdk-v* tag

mcp_connector.distribution: npm: delentia-mcp (repository delentia-labs/delentia-mcp, not this one)
mcp_connector.version_rule: its own package.json in that repository; this repository does not read it. Its MCP protocol revision is declared there, not here

tauri_desktop_shell.version_rule: no release exists; its number is not a release number and makes no claim
